instruction.text: Select the card with <m-yellow>3 yellow</m-yellow> stars.
instruction.sound: Look closely and count. Select the card with three yellow stars.

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-purple>2 purple</m-purple> circles.
instruction.sound: And where can you see <m-purple>2 purple</m-purple> circles?

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-red>1 red</m-red> heart.
instruction.sound: Where can you see one red heart?

instruction.text: Select <u>all</u> the cards with <m-purple>3 purple</m-purple> circles.
instruction.sound: Now select all the cards with <m-purple>3 purple</m-purple> circles.

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-blue>1 blue</m-blue> square.
instruction.sound: We have some new cards. Select the card with one blue square.

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-purple>3 purple</m-purple> circles.
instruction.sound: On which card can you see <m-purple>3 purple</m-purple> circles?

instruction.text: Select <u>all</u> the cards with <m-green>2 green</m-green> triangles.
instruction.sound: Select all the cards with 2 green triangles.

instruction.text: Select <u>all</u> the cards with <m-blue>2 blue</m-blue> squares.
instruction.sound: And all the cards with <m-blue>2 blue</m-blue> squares.

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-red>3 red</m-red> hearts.
instruction.sound: Here are some new cards again. Where can you see <m-red>3 red</m-red> hearts?

instruction.text: Select the card with <m-blue>3 blue</m-blue> arrows.
instruction.sound: And where can you see three blue arrows?

instruction.text: Select all the cards with <m-red>2 red</m-red> hearts.
instruction.sound: Select all the cards with 2 red hearts.

instruction.text: Select all the cards with <m-blue>1 blue</m-blue> arrow.
instruction.sound: Finally, select all the cards with one blue arrow.
